sentences.hanzi: 立冬这天，小明和丽丽帮奶奶腌白菜。
sentences.pinyin: Lìdōng zhè tiān, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì bāng nǎinai yān báicài.
sentences.english: On the day of Start of Winter, Xiaoming and Lili helped Grandma pickle Chinese cabbage.

sentences.hanzi: 天气很冷，但是院子里有很多白菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì yuànzi lǐ yǒu hěn duō báicài.
sentences.english: The weather was very cold, but there were many cabbages in the yard.

sentences.hanzi: 小明问丽丽：“奶奶说今天要腌白菜，你知道怎么做吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn Lìlì: "Nǎinai shuō jīntiān yào yān báicài, nǐ zhīdào zěnme zuò ma?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked Lili, "Grandma said today we're going to pickle cabbage; do you know how to do it?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我也不太清楚，我们问奶奶吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yě bú tài qīngchu, wǒmen wèn nǎinai ba."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I'm not sure either; let's ask Grandma."

sentences.hanzi: 他们走进屋子，奶奶正在洗菜。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu jìn wūzi, nǎinai zhèngzài xǐ cài.
sentences.english: They walked into the house, and Grandma was washing vegetables.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“奶奶，您能教我们腌白菜吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Nǎinai, nín néng jiāo wǒmen yān báicài ma?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Grandma, can you teach us how to pickle cabbage?"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶笑着回答：“当然可以，我们先去洗手吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xiàozhe huídá: "Dāngrán kěyǐ, wǒmen xiān qù xǐ shǒu ba."
sentences.english: Grandma smiled and replied, "Of course. Let's go wash our hands first."

sentences.hanzi: 他们洗好手，奶奶把白菜洗干净，切成两半。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xǐ hǎo shǒu, nǎinai bǎ báicài xǐ gānjìng, qiē chéng liǎng bàn.
sentences.english: After they washed their hands, Grandma washed the cabbage clean and cut it in half.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽拿来一个大罐子。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì ná lái yí gè dà guànzi.
sentences.english: Lili brought over a big jar.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“先在罐子里放一层盐，再放一层白菜。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Xiān zài guànzi lǐ fàng yì céng yán, zài fàng yì céng báicài."
sentences.english: Grandma said, "First put a layer of salt in the jar, then a layer of cabbage."

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽一起放盐和白菜。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yìqǐ fàng yán hé báicài.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili together put in salt and cabbage.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“要用力压一压，这样菜会出很多水。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Yào yòng lì yā yì yā, zhèyàng cài huì chū hěn duō shuǐ."
sentences.english: Grandma said, "Press it firmly; this way the cabbage will release a lot of water."

sentences.hanzi: 他们用手压白菜。手很凉，但是他们很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòng shǒu yā báicài. Shǒu hěn liáng, dànshì tāmen hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: They pressed the cabbage with their hands. Their hands were very cold, but they were very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“奶奶，水真的出来了！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Nǎinai, shuǐ zhēn de chūlái le!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "Grandma, the water really came out!"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“很好。现在把罐子盖好，放在阴凉的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Hěn hǎo. Xiànzài bǎ guànzi gài hǎo, fàng zài yīnliáng de dìfang."
sentences.english: Grandma said, "Very good. Now cover the jar and put it in a cool, shady place."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶又说：“过二十天，酸菜就可以吃了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai yòu shuō: "Guò èrshí tiān, suāncài jiù kěyǐ chī le."
sentences.english: Grandma also said, "In twenty days, the pickled cabbage will be ready to eat."

sentences.hanzi: 小明问：“为什么酸菜会变酸？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: "Wèishénme suāncài huì biàn suān?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, "Why does pickled cabbage turn sour?"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“因为盐和白菜在一起，经过一些时间，菜就会变酸。这是冬天储存食物的好方法。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō: "Yīnwèi yán hé báicài zài yìqǐ, jīngguò yìxiē shíjiān, cài jiù huì biàn suān. Zhè shì dōngtiān chǔcún shíwù de hǎo fāngfǎ."
sentences.english: Grandma said, "Because salt and cabbage are put together, after some time the cabbage will turn sour. This is a good way to store food in winter."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我希望冬天快点到，我想吃我们做的酸菜。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ xīwàng dōngtiān kuài diǎn dào, wǒ xiǎng chī wǒmen zuò de suāncài."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I hope winter comes soon; I want to eat the pickled cabbage we made."

sentences.hanzi: 小明也说：“我也是。自己做的酸菜一定很好吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě shuō: "Wǒ yě shì. Zìjǐ zuò de suāncài yídìng hěn hǎochī."
sentences.english: Xiaoming also said, "Me too. Pickled cabbage made by ourselves must be very delicious."

sentences.hanzi: 冬天来了，他们打开罐子，酸菜做好了。
sentences.pinyin: Dōngtiān lái le, tāmen dǎkāi guànzi, suāncài zuò hǎo le.
sentences.english: Winter came, they opened the jar, and the pickled cabbage was ready.

sentences.hanzi: 全家人一起吃酸菜，小明和丽丽觉得特别香。
sentences.pinyin: Quánjiā rén yìqǐ chī suāncài, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì juéde tèbié xiāng.
sentences.english: The whole family ate the pickled cabbage together, and Xiaoming and Lili found it especially delicious.

sentences.hanzi: 他们学会了冬天储存食物的方法。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xuéhuì le dōngtiān chǔcún shíwù de fāngfǎ.
sentences.english: They learned a way to store food in winter.
